nodes.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra Autonomous Agent System
nodes.docstring: Enterprise autonomous software engineering platform with dual-engine routing and warm sand studio UI.

metadata.architecture: Multi-tier agentic orchestrator with verification gates and real-time streaming
metadata.backend_tech: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PostgreSQL, Redis, vLLM
metadata.frontend_tech: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript 5, SSE

nodes.name: nemotron-agent-engine
nodes.docstring: FastAPI asynchronous agent backend, repository intelligence graph, and model gateway.

nodes.name: nemotron-agent-frontend
nodes.docstring: Next.js 16 reactive frontend studio with Warm Sand light theme and mission control.

nodes.name: Autonomous Software Engineering
nodes.docstring: End-to-end plan creation, tool-based file editing, test execution, bounded debugging, and git diff generation.

nodes.name: Codebase Architectural Governance
nodes.docstring: Repository AST parsing, import cycle detection, layer boundary integrity, and 8-gate fail-fast verification.

nodes.name: Multi-Model Inference Routing
nodes.docstring: Audited 18-step model gateway with automatic failover between Nemotron 3 Ultra, Groq, and Jio Gemini.

nodes.name: Financial Cost Observability
nodes.docstring: Real-time token breakdown, amortized cloud compute tracking (GCP Spot / RunPod), and budget circuit breakers.

nodes.name: Identity & Secret Management
nodes.docstring: Argon2id authentication, RFC 9700 refresh token rotation, superuser API key issuance, and SSRF filter.

nodes.name: Real-Time Developer Interaction
nodes.docstring: Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming of agent thought chains, terminal outputs, and interactive permission gates.

nodes.name: Autonomous Mission Lifecycle
nodes.docstring: Provides persistent mission state tracking, interactive plan approval, rollback checkpoints, and git diff review.

nodes.name: Multi-Role Agent Orchestrator
nodes.docstring: Coordinates specialized roles: Planner, Reviewer, Coder, Tester, and Debugger with scope containment.

nodes.name: 8-Gate Verification Pipeline
nodes.docstring: Executes 8 fail-fast verification gates (AST syntax, imports, types, architecture, scope, tests) before commit.

nodes.name: 18-Step Audited Model Gateway
nodes.docstring: Enforces 18-step verification on every LLM call: auth, quota, tenant isolation, credentials, and usage audit.

nodes.name: Cost & Token Analytics Engine
nodes.docstring: Tracks prompt/completion/thinking tokens, computes GCP Spot / RunPod amortization, and enforces budget guards.

nodes.name: Identity, API Key & SSRF Security
nodes.docstring: Manages users, organizations, API key issuance, refresh token families, and private subnet IP blocking.

nodes.name: AST Codebase & Impact Intelligence
nodes.docstring: Extracts symbol call graphs, resolves imports, tracks file fingerprints, and computes blast radius.

nodes.name: Agent Constitutional Governance
nodes.docstring: Enforces quality rules, bootstrapping of .agent/ structure, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

nodes.name: Warm Sand Agent Frontend Studio
nodes.docstring: Next.js 16 dashboard with Mission Control, Thought Stream, Terminal, and Superuser API Key Manager.

nodes.name: Task Scope Lock & Confinement
nodes.docstring: File modifications are strictly prohibited outside the authorized TaskScope whitelist. Violations halt execution.

nodes.name: Bounded Self-Correction (Max 3 Fixes)
nodes.docstring: Automated test-fix cycles are capped at 3 iterations. If errors persist, all changes must be rolled back.

nodes.name: Fail-Fast 8-Gate Pipeline Battery
nodes.docstring: Sequential evaluation of Syntax -> Imports -> Types -> Architecture -> Scope -> Tests -> Lint. Halts on first failure.

nodes.name: 18-Step Audited Model Gateway Invariant
nodes.docstring: Every model request must pass 18 sequential verification checks before provider dispatch, with immutable audit logging.

nodes.name: Quota & Token Rate Limiting
nodes.docstring: Tenant request and token quotas are verified in Redis prior to model execution. Rejections emit 429 Too Many Requests.

nodes.name: SSRF IP Denylist Filtering
nodes.docstring: Outbound network calls to RFC 1918 private subnets (10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254) are rejected.

nodes.name: Human-in-the-Loop Permission Gating
nodes.docstring: High-risk terminal commands (rm -rf, DROP TABLE, pkill, git push -f) pause execution until explicit human authorization.

nodes.name: Daily Financial Budget Circuit Breaker
nodes.docstring: When token expenditures exceed the configured daily budget threshold, execution is halted with CRITICAL alert level.

nodes.name: RFC 9700 Refresh Token Family Rotation
nodes.docstring: Refresh tokens are strictly single-use. Re-use of an already consumed token revokes the entire token family.

nodes.name: Discrete State Transition Conformance
nodes.docstring: Mission state changes must strictly follow the defined VALID_TRANSITIONS graph. Illegal jumps raise InvalidStateError.

nodes.name: Autonomous Mission Execution Journey
nodes.docstring: Developer submits goal in UI -> AST context gathered -> Multi-stage plan created -> Developer approves plan -> Agent executes tools -> 8-Gate verification runs -> Git diff presented.

nodes.name: Superuser API Key Provisioning
nodes.docstring: Superuser logs into console -> Enters tenant details -> Backend generates Argon2id hashed key -> Returns key with role scopes.

nodes.name: Multi-Model Fast Failover Stream
nodes.docstring: Client connects to SSE -> Gateway attempts Nemotron 3 Ultra -> If offline, failover to Gemini 2.5 Flash -> Stream tokens to UI.

nodes.name: Mission Cost Ledger & Financial Audit
nodes.docstring: Mission finishes turn -> Prompt and completion tokens tallied -> Cost amortized against Spot rates -> Written to PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: Constitutional Repository Scaffolding
nodes.docstring: Admin issues POST /constitution/scaffold -> Engine writes .agent/ coding standards, testing rules, and ADR templates.

nodes.name: Parallel Agent Endpoint Surface Duplication
nodes.docstring: The backend exposes both legacy `/api/v1/agent/*` and primary `/api/v1/missions/*`. While preserving backwards compatibility, maintenance of two parallel routing pipelines risks drift.

nodes.name: Frontend SSE Hook Targets Legacy Route
nodes.docstring: `useAgentStream.ts` in the frontend connects to `/api/v1/agent/stream/{id}` instead of `/api/v1/missions/{id}/stream`. Both stream events, but `/missions` supports full persistence and interactive plan approval.

nodes.name: Alembic Base Partial ORM Model Registration
nodes.docstring: `app/db/base.py` currently imports only `CostRecord` instead of all SQLAlchemy models (`Mission`, `User`, `RegisteredModel`), which could cause autogenerate migrations to omit mission tables.

nodes.name: Cross-Project TaskScope Confinement Boundary
nodes.docstring: The backend and frontend live in adjacent directories (`/nemotron-agent-engine` and `/nemotron-agent-frontend`). Backend `TaskScope` by default locks to engine root, requiring explicit cross-workspace paths for full-stack edits.
